_comment: RECOMMENDED NATIVE-SANDBOX SETTINGS — the default isolation tier (macOS Seatbelt /
Linux+WSL2 bubblewrap). Copy the 'sandbox' block into .claude/settings.json, or use
/sandbox inside Claude Code to enable it per-project. Zero Docker steps required.
macOS needs nothing installed; Linux/WSL2 needs bubblewrap + socat first — see
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing for setup and the full reference.
THE THREE LAYERS (see the README's Security Model section):
1. native sandbox  = spatial boundary — OS-enforced filesystem/network limits
2. bash-guard hook = semantic boundary within it — blocks destructive patterns
(rm -rf ., hard resets, publishes) the spatial boundary permits in cwd
3. permissions     = convenience layer — what runs without prompting
allowedDomains mirrors the Docker firewall's core set (sandbox/init-firewall.sh):
Anthropic + GitHub. Add your stack's package registry, mirroring the firewall's
per-language table:
node:   registry.npmjs.org, www.npmjs.com
python: pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org
rust:   crates.io, static.crates.io, index.crates.io
go:     proxy.golang.org, sum.golang.org
ruby:   rubygems.org, index.rubygems.org
jvm:    repo.maven.apache.org, repo1.maven.org
dotnet: api.nuget.org
elixir: hex.pm, repo.hex.pm, builds.hex.pm
denyRead mirrors the permission denies (Read(**/.env), Read(**/.env.*),
Read(**/secrets/**)). Sandbox paths are literal paths, not globs; './' and
prefix-less entries resolve to the PROJECT ROOT when the block lives in project
settings (.claude/settings.json) — so './secrets' denies <project>/secrets.
Add further .env.* variants and nested locations your repo actually has.
The default read policy allows ~/.ssh and ~/.aws; deny them here too if your
threat model calls for it.
NESTING: pick ONE tier per project. Running this native sandbox inside the Docker
sandbox requires enableWeakerNestedSandbox, which weakens isolation — if you need
the container (reproducibility, --dangerously-skip-permissions autonomy, or a
platform without native support), use 'make sandbox' and leave this disabled.
